title: Positivity of Pre-Canonical Bases for Spherical Hecke Algebras
summary: We introduce a new algorithm for computing Kostka-Foulkes polynomials. It arises from a combinatorial procedure that computes the transition coefficients between successive pre-canonical bases for spherical Hecke algebras, introduced by Libedinsky, Patimo, and the first author, in order to interpolate between the standard and canonical bases of the spherical Hecke algebras. Using this algorithm, we prove that the coefficients of the polynomials in the transition matrix from any pre-canonical basis to the next one has nonnegative coefficients.
